N-add12#1.zh: 站住！你们是什么人，竟敢擅自闯上二龙山！
N-add12#1.t: Halt! Who are you, daring to barge up Twin Dragon Mountain?

N-add12#2.zh: 小人等是山下近村的庄家。这个胖和尚常来村里吃酒，吃醉了不肯还钱，口里还说要去叫人来打你山寨。小人们灌醉了他，拿条索子绑了，特来献与大王。
N-add12#2.t: We're farmers from the village below. This fat monk keeps coming to drink in the village, won't pay when he's drunk, and says he'll fetch men to attack your stronghold. We got him drunk, tied him up with rope, and brought him to present to the Great King.

N-add12#3.zh: 哈哈！原来是这个秃驴！押上山来，交给大头领发落！
N-add12#3.t: Haha! So it's this bald donkey! Bring him up the mountain for the Chief to deal with!

N-add12#4.zh: （洒家这索子只是个活结，一扯便开。）
N-add12#4.t: (This rope is only a slipknot. One tug and it's off.)

N-add12#5.zh: 林冲、史进等人已绕到山门附近藏好，只等号令。押着鲁智深一路走到山门前，路上千万不可先动手：混进山门，山门头领那一营就措手不及，打倒头领还能收服一半喽啰。
N-add12#5.t: Lin Chong, Shi Jin and the others have circled round and are hiding near the mountain gate, waiting for the signal. Escort Lu Zhishen all the way to the gate and don't strike first on the way: get inside the gate and the gate chief's camp is caught off guard; defeat the chief and half his men will surrender.

N-add12#7.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人（杨志押着鲁智深混进山门；打倒山门头领，剩下的喽啰一半归顺）
N-add12#7.t: Victory --- Defeat all enemies (Yang Zhi escorts Lu Zhishen through the mountain gate; defeat the gate chief and half the remaining bandits surrender)

N-add12#9.zh: 失败条件二 --- 杨志死亡

N-add12#11.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add12#12.zh: %N死亡，众人不敌盗贼围攻，荒野平添几缕英魂........
N-add12#12.t: %N died. The heroes couldn't withstand the bandits' siege, and a few more brave souls haunted the wilds........

N-add12#13.zh: 杨志不幸战死，%N与众人逃往山下，途中遇见狼群，一干人等无力再战，终成狼群腹中美食........
N-add12#13.t: Yang Zhi fell in battle. %N and the others fled down the mountain, met a pack of wolves on the way, had no strength left to fight, and ended up as the wolves' dinner........

N-add12#14.zh: 经过一场苦战，终于可以进入二龙山了。
N-add12#14.t: After a hard fight, the way into Twin Dragon Mountain is finally open.

N-add12#15.zh: 把这秃驴押过来，让俺先打他几下出气！
N-add12#15.t: Bring that bald donkey over here and let me beat him a few times to cool off!

N-add12#16.zh: 鲁智深把索头只一拽，拽脱了活结，夺过一条禅杖，抡将起来。
N-add12#16.t: Lu Zhishen gave the rope one tug, pulled the slipknot free, snatched a staff and set it whirling.

N-add12#17.t: Here I am! Who dares come at me!

N-add12#19.zh: 山门里的伏兵一齐杀出；林冲、史进等人也从山下杀了上来！
N-add12#19.t: The ambushers inside the gate burst out together; Lin Chong, Shi Jin and the others charged up from below as well!

N-add12#20.zh: 山门头领万没料到绑来的和尚会挣脱，营中一时措手不及，都呆住了！可山下也冒出一伙埋伏的喽啰，抄了后路。
N-add12#20.t: The gate chief never expected the bound monk to break free. His camp was caught off guard and stood frozen! But a band of bandits lying in ambush also appeared below and cut off the way back.

N-add12#21.zh: 不好！这伙人是来打山寨的！
N-add12#21.t: Oh no! These people have come to attack the stronghold!

N-add12#22.zh: 露了馅也罢，洒家不装了！
N-add12#22.t: The game's up? Fine, I'm done pretending!

N-add12#23.zh: 林冲、史进等人从山下杀了上来！
N-add12#23.t: Lin Chong, Shi Jin and the others charged up from below!

N-add12#24.zh: 山门头领一倒，众喽啰没了主心骨，山上原有的喽啰倒有三成丢下刀枪，情愿归顺！
N-add12#24.t: With the gate chief down, the bandits lost their backbone. A good third of those already on the mountain threw down their weapons and offered to surrender!

N-add12#25.zh: 头领都没了，还替谁卖命！俺们情愿跟着好汉们干！
N-add12#25.t: Our chief is gone. Who are we fighting for? We'll follow you heroes!

N-add12#26.zh: 弟兄们，掉转枪头，跟着鲁大师打上山去！
N-add12#26.t: Brothers, turn your spears around and follow Master Lu up the mountain!

N-add12#27.zh: 后来赶到的伏兵、援兵见头领已死，又有自家弟兄倒戈，一时乱作一团。
N-add12#27.t: The ambushers and reinforcements arriving later saw their chief dead and their own brothers turning on them, and fell into chaos.

N-add12#28.zh: 怎么自家弟兄倒打过来了？这仗到底帮哪边？
N-add12#28.t: Why are our own brothers attacking us? Whose side are we on?

N-add12#29.zh: 头领死了！乱了乱了，谁来发个号令啊！
N-add12#29.t: The chief is dead! It's chaos! Somebody give an order!
